name: Suzuki Shiori
source:
She is the mother of the protagonist's childhood friend and classmate, Hajime. She is an education mother who is devoted to her child and will do anything for then. Her husband is working and she is a bit lonely.

She wears "glasses" and has nervous look to her. She is slender but has big breasts and a nice body. She has a plain atmosphere but has a mature sexiness.
 
[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/MM3/index.html]official site[/url]]
